top_gotchas.gotcha: Async functions cannot directly recurse — Future size becomes infinite.
.unwrap() panics on Err/None. In production, prefer ? or .expect("reason").
`any` opts out of type-checking. Prefer `unknown` and narrow at use sites.
Hardcoded secret-like identifier in source. Rotate immediately if leaked.
Mutable default arguments (list, dict) are shared across calls — leads to silent state leaks.
Bare `except:` catches everything including KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit.
